name: Weekly review synthesis
description: Turn department reviews into prioritized action items for the next week.

steps.title: Capture what worked
steps.instruction: List the top 3 wins from growth, monetization, sales, and success reviews.

steps.title: Capture what broke
steps.instruction: List bottlenecks, missed targets, and root causes from each department review.

steps.title: Set top 3 priorities
steps.instruction: Pick three priorities for next week and assign an owning department to each.
